title: Lao PDR Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Country climate-development findings and priority recommendations summarized in the 2026 CCDR page.
methodology: Official World Bank CCDR summary page presenting selected report findings and recommendations.
limitations: This is an overview, not the full report; most findings lack detailed geographic estimates on the page.

title: Lao PDR’s 2020 Updated and Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution
temporal_coverage: Historical disaster impacts and national climate vulnerability described in the 2020 updated NDC submitted in May 2021.
methodology: Government NDC synthesizing cited disaster assessments and regional climate projections.
limitations: The NDC summarizes prior assessments and projections; underlying event and climate-model methods vary by citation.

title: Mid-Term Evaluation Report: Integrated Water Resource Management and Ecosystem-based Adaptation in the Xe Bang Hieng River Basin and Luang Prabang City
organization: UNDP, Global Environment Facility project evaluation
temporal_coverage: Midterm evaluation fieldwork September 2024–January 2025; project activity through 2024.
methodology: Independent midterm evaluation using document review, stakeholder interviews, field missions and participatory rural appraisal in Luang Prabang and Savannakhet.
limitations: Midterm findings cover project sites; beneficiary estimates and outcomes were weak.

title: Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems 2024: Lao PDR country perspective
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
geographic_coverage: Lao PDR national and village disaster management systems
temporal_coverage: Country case study in the 2024 global report.
methodology: Global report presenting national early-warning-system case studies; Lao PDR country perspective is available on the official report page.
limitations: The consulted country summary gives no subnational coverage statistics or outcome evaluation.

title: FAO and Partners Conclude Anticipatory Action Project in Lao People's Democratic Republic, Strengthening Flood Resilience
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: Project delivery August 2024–May 2025; flood protocol activations in September 2024.
methodology: FAO project-completion account summarizing two protocol activations, household support and capacity-building outputs.
limitations: Agency-reported output totals, not an independent impact evaluation; the release describes project delivery rather than population-wide effects.

title: UNFPA, Lao Women’s Union, and Australia Deliver Essential Support for Women and Girls Affected by the Floods in Laos
organization: United Nations Population Fund Lao PDR
temporal_coverage: Flood response and field needs assessment in 2024.
methodology: UNFPA press release reporting government/NGO/UN disaster-response assessment findings and relief handover.
limitations: Operational update, not a prevalence study or independent evaluation of gender-based violence or relief outcomes.
